service.ar: معادلة شهادة الصف الثاني عشر الصادرة من خارج الدولة

about: Get a Grade 12 certificate issued outside the UAE recognised as equivalent.
note: Requirements read from the official MOE service page on the checked date. MOE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Grade 12 certificate equivalency (from abroad). Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Certificate is checked for authenticity and the issuing institute's recognition
Distance-learning, open school and GED style certificates are not equalised
documents: Attested high school certificate and the two previous years' certificates
Job offer letter (for work) or university admission letter (for study)
Attested legal translation if not in Arabic or English
Grade 12 transcript and certificate attested by UAE MOFA
PDF only, up to 5 MB per file
timing: 3 to 5 working days if everything is in order
Up to 30 working days if a committee review and extra correspondence are needed
channels: MOE website or smart app, sign in with UAE PASS
